reason: The goal calls for cutting the marked slits in the drum wall.
expectation: The marked viewing slits will be cut into the wall.

effect: The slits are cut, and the next goal is to roll the wall.
reaction: The joined lower band makes the slit strip's construction clear.
reason: The new goal explicitly calls for rolling the drum wall.
expectation: The slit strip will curl into a drum shape.

effect: The wall is now a cylinder, and its seam needs securing.
reaction: The downward tabs make the next stage of the construction visible.
reason: The goal calls for taping the drum's seam, and Tape is available.
expectation: The tape will secure the cylindrical drum's seam.

effect: The tape secured the seam, completing this chapter's goals.
reaction: The visible green strip makes the fastening clear, though I was surprised the chapter ended before the referenced drum was complete.

mostWorthwhile.text: Rolling the slit wall into a cylinder was the most worthwhile transformation: it made the drum shape clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taping the seam was straightforward but less interesting than forming the cylinder.

surprise.text: The chapter ended after taping the seam, although the build reference also showed a base and fish.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each followed a clear construction goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the slits and drum become an animation toy; the construction so far was clear, if brief.
